summary: Clarivate Plc completed the previously announced sale of its Life Sciences and Healthcare business to an affiliate of Altaris, LLC under a Stock and Asset Purchase Agreement dated July 3, 2026. At closing on October 6, 2026, the buyer paid $500 million cash, subject to customary adjustments, plus a $75 million unsecured senior note; an additional $25 million deferred consideration is payable by January 31, 2028, tied to transition-services completion. President Henry Levy terminated employment at closing under a retention agreement. Total stated consideration is $600 million; no board recommendation or advisor named. Watch deferred-payment and note-recovery risk, transition-services execution, and pro forma deleveraging.
